title: Zeus Juice Vermilion E-Liquid 50ml Shortfill
description: Vermilion by Zeus Juice is mouth-watering blend of juicy, slightly sour cherries blended with ripe, tangy red berries and a soothing streak of menthol on the exhale. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70% VG 30% PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , vape box mods and sub-ohm tanks .
